svg.text: Triton’s coalesce pass: changing which thread loads which element
a whole row apart in memory:
each 4-byte load hits a different line
each thread holds 4 floats in a row:
Colour = which thread owns the element (a small 8 × 16 corner of a 64 × 64 tile, stored row by row).
The kernel code does not change at all. Only the layout attached to the tensor does.
Layouts from Triton’s own coalesce test (test/TritonGPU/coalesce.mlir); drawing simplified to a corner of the tile.
